news.title: Melania Trump brokers localised Russia-Ukraine ceasefire for aid in Oleshky
news.description: First lady Melania Trump has brokered a ceasefire between Russia and Ukraine in the ravaged, Russian-occupied Ukrainian city of Oleshky so that humanitarian aid can be delivered and civilians can be evacuated from a place she said is "on the brink of disaster…
